offlist.t: Maximum cells a bishop can cover in k moves on an M x N board
offlist.s: Walmart OA (college not given), coding question 2 of 2
offlist.why: Only the one-line statement was reported: no constraints, input format or examples. It doesn't say whether the starting cell counts, whether cells can be revisited, or what "in k moves" allows (each move can slide any distance), so the answer would be a guess.

Django models: Entity, File and Directory, with an ls() method and validation
offlist.s: Walmart OA, IIT Kharagpur (the second coding question; the first was the three-servers question)
offlist.why: Only an outline was reported: three classes in models.py, an ls() method on Directory, and a parent field that must be a Directory (anything else raises an error). The attribute names and validation rules weren't given. AI help was allowed for syntax only.
Only the count and the topic were reported.
